tracks.srt_text:
1
00:00:00,000 --> 00:00:10,640
Once upon a time, in a sunny meadow, lived a very fast Hare who loved to boast.

2
00:00:11,340 --> 00:00:19,100
He often teased the slow, quiet Tortoise, who always took his time.

3
00:00:19,800 --> 00:00:28,240
One day, the Hare challenged the Tortoise to a race to prove who was swifter.

4
00:00:28,940 --> 00:00:34,340
The Tortoise, though doubtful, bravely agreed.

5
00:00:35,040 --> 00:00:43,920
The race began! Zoom! The Hare dashed away, a blur of blue and white.

6
00:00:44,720 --> 00:00:53,600
The Tortoise started slowly, one steady step after another.

7
00:00:54,300 --> 00:01:02,860
Soon, the Hare was far, far ahead. He decided to take a little nap.

8
00:01:03,660 --> 00:01:11,220
He snuggled under a big, leafy tree and quickly fell asleep.

9
00:01:11,920 --> 00:01:20,080
Meanwhile, the Tortoise kept walking, slowly and without stopping.

10
00:01:20,780 --> 00:01:29,500
Step by step, he came closer and closer to the sleeping Hare.

11
00:01:30,300 --> 00:01:38,380
At last, the Hare woke up, stretched, and looked around.

12
00:01:39,080 --> 00:01:46,520
He couldn't believe his eyes! The Tortoise was almost at the finish line!

13
00:01:47,320 --> 00:01:53,400
The Hare zoomed off again, running as fast as he could.

14
00:01:54,100 --> 00:02:01,420
But it was too late! The Tortoise crossed the finish line with a smile.

15
00:02:02,220 --> 00:02:10,700
Everyone cheered for the Tortoise, who proved that slow and steady can win the race!
